evidence_search.notes: Current screen reads the repository-preserved source-attributed evidence and complete episode inventory. It does not claim fresh full-text access to every originating source. No canonical restamp or independent source verification is implied.

episode_inventory.purpose: Present source-backed material actions and later responses in supported relative order. Separate runs, source attributions and unknown ordering remain explicit.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The researcher used fake credentials and captured file contents in model-turn requests and session archives after file reads.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Synthetic probes show observed transmission, not real-customer secret loss.

clauses.source_paraphrase: In separate tests, the CLI uploaded tracked files and Git history even when told not to open files. Unread canaries were recovered from uploaded bundles on two repositories.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Task-local access does not itself authorise independent repository-wide storage.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The CLI sent tracked files beyond those the bounded coding task needed or the agent read, so task-local permission was extended to repository-wide storage transfer in the observed implementation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: A larger test captured 5.10 GiB before being stopped. Storage accepted uploads despite model quota errors. Turning off model improvement did not stop bundle transmission.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Storage transfer, model processing and training preferences are separate pathways.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The researcher retracted an earlier inference that large transfers failed locally. Process-scoped network measurement had missed the separate uploader.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A corrected observation supersedes an incomplete measurement.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The researcher later observed server-side upload disablement on the tested account. A separately tested privacy option governed retention; promised deletion was unconfirmed.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Observed containment must retain its account scope and distinguish transmission from retention.

notes: Test canaries are not real leaked customer secrets. Training use is not established by upload or a model-improvement toggle. FC-055 needs actual secondary-purpose use, not storage alone. FC-002 capability-as-permission is not independently established by the scope crossing. The later server-side disablement remains account-scoped; deletion is unverified.
